subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should maintainers prefer this PR's stale-internal-drop rule or the open preserve-as-context repair in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 for the canonical queued/orphaned stale-reply issue?
rationale: Both open PRs target the same session-state bug but intentionally choose different model-visible prompt semantics, so automation cannot safely choose the product/runtime contract.

options.title: Choose canonical semantics first
options.body: Pause merge until maintainers pick stale-internal-drop versus preserve-as-context as the supported orphan-repair contract.

options.title: Land this narrow rule
options.body: Proceed with this PR only after redacted embedded-agent runtime proof shows the six-tool drop scope and `sessions_send` preservation work in a real run.

options.title: Close after the broader PR lands
options.body: If maintainers choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759, close this branch as superseded once that PR is merged or explicitly adopted as canonical.

recommendation.title: Choose canonical semantics first
recommendation.body: Pause merge until maintainers pick stale-internal-drop versus preserve-as-context as the supported orphan-repair contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the active-turn queued-user preservation invariant introduced in PR 65478.
